The warning signs

Does this sound familiar?

When the numbers are hard to trust, even routine decisions start to feel like guesswork.

01
Bank balances do not match

QuickBooks says one thing; your bank statement says another.

02
Months have not been reconciled

Transactions have piled up without a clear starting point.

03
Transactions are uncategorized

Expenses sit in “Ask My Accountant” or the wrong accounts.

04
Reports do not make sense

Your Profit & Loss does not reflect what you think you earned.

05
Taxes are approaching

Your preparer needs the books fixed before filing can move forward.

06
You need financing

You need dependable statements for a lender or a business decision.

Common questions

What to expect

How long does a cleanup take?

A straightforward cleanup may take 2–4 weeks. Moderate projects often take 4–8 weeks, while complex work can take 8–12 weeks or longer. The Diagnostic Review gives you a more useful timeline for your file.

Can you fix several years of books?

Yes. Jon works through multi-year cleanup in sequence so the financial history holds together going forward.

Do you work remotely?

Yes. The initial Financial Health Scan is a Zoom call, and Jon works virtually with clients across the country.

Is the Financial Health Scan really free?

Yes. It is a complimentary 30-minute introductory call. The deeper Diagnostic Review is a separate paid service with a flat fee.
